text: Closed as SUPERSEDED 2026-09-17. Premise (local amrlib subprocess with pinned runtime weights) was superseded by ADR 0008 on 2026-09-01: the runtime is a hosted model behind ClaudeParserTransport (provider-agent), and ADR 0008 states a hosted model's weights cannot be pinned. Dependents E0 (bd-01M1CQSWJ538PAEME49200YARR) and P1B (bd-01M1DB6J4VFETMCFG096713DCY) are re-pointed off this bead. See docs/plans/2026-09-17-one-point-oh-handoff.md section 4.
